title: One thing about me- I *love* a first preview!! #Broadway #OurTown #Ou...
transcript: Here is everything I got for attending the first preview of our town on Broadway. So the first thing that we got is a copy of the play itself. The play came with this cute little postcard that says, Warm Greetings from Grover's Corners. Uh, it has a photo of the cast, and then on the back it says, welcome to the first preview performance of our town. I absolutely love when shows give you a copy of the script, or even just have one available to purchase. We are very bad here in America at publishing shows in a timely manner, so it's definitely not feasible for all shows, especially newer shows. Uh, but the shows that are able to make the script available, I think it is so smart, and I cannot wait to dive into this thing. Today was also National Voter Registration Day, so every playbill had this slip to check your voting status and make sure you register to vote. Uh, which I love that they do this. Voting is so important, and this is your reminder, if you haven't already. And finally, perhaps the strangest is we had this print out of the Playbill cover. Now, it took me a little while to figure out what the difference was, but I finally found it. So if you look carefully at the Playbill, uh, two of the headshots are, like, fully cut off. And then in the print out version, uh, they fixed those headshots. Another kind of weird change is that the new Playbill cover says the Ethel Barrymore Theater. Or as the original just says, Ethel Barrymore Theater. So I'm very curious about that as well. If you are someone that collects playbills, specifically rare playbills, uh, this might be one to add to your collection. I'm assuming it's only gonna be out for the first week, and then they'll fix the Playbill cover. Uh, so the misprint Playbill covers will probably only be in circulation for a week. Uh, and it's kind of a cool piece to have.
classificationReason: Creator attended first preview and shows merchandise/materials received, but doesn't share opinions about the actual production - just excitement about getting the script and voting materials
